description: Connects a LOINC laboratory test to the organism its Component-axis measurement measures or is about.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing the relationship; contains LOINC.

source_contributions.scope: Laboratory codes with CLASSTYPE = 1 and status ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED; DEPRECATED codes are excluded. Targets are NCBI Taxonomy organisms present in SPOKE; BV-BRC organisms and the generic Viruses (NCBITaxon:10239), Bacteria (NCBITaxon:2), and Fungi (NCBITaxon:4751) targets are excluded.
source_contributions.description: The organism is the analyte-related target, rather than the specimen in which a measurement is taken. Where an analyte part has candidate taxa related by ancestry, only the most specific taxa are retained; candidates without an is-a relationship may coexist. Provocation agents are excluded from analyte relationships. Pathogen nucleic-acid tests measure RNA or DNA and are represented as Compound relationships instead.
